runs.title: Payroll runs
runs.description: Draft → Calculated → Under review → Approved (by a second person) → Released. Released runs are locked.
runs.emptyDescription: Create a run for a month to calculate salaries.

newRun.title: New payroll run
newRun.description: Uses the company proration basis and every approved unpaid leave and adjustment for the month.

run.heading: {period} payroll
run.notCalculatedBody: Calculate to compute every employee's pay for the month. You can recalculate as often as needed until the run is submitted.
run.blockingTitle: {count, plural, one {# blocking issue} other {# blocking issues}}
run.blockingBody: Fix the data (e.g. add a salary or IBAN) and recalculate, or hold/exclude those employees before submitting.

actions.releaseDescription: The run is locked, payslips are issued and every employee is notified. Only a Super Admin can reopen it afterwards.
actions.approveDescription: You confirm you reviewed the register and variances.
actions.sendBackDescription: The run returns to Calculated so it can be fixed and recalculated.
actions.cancelDescription: Cancelled runs are kept for the record but can't be changed. Employees in it can be paid in a new run.
actions.reopenDescription: Payslips are withdrawn from employees and the run returns to Calculated. Everything is audited.

entryStatus.description: Held and excluded employees are not in the WPS or bank files and get no payslip from this run.
entryStatus.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Pending clearance, bank details wrong

issues.noStructure: No salary structure in effect for this period
issues.noStructureBefore: No salary structure before {date} — those days are unpaid
issues.noIban: No IBAN — cannot be paid by bank transfer / WPS
issues.noRoutingCode: No bank routing code (needed for the WPS file)
issues.noLabourCard: No labour card number (needed for the WPS file)
issues.variance: Net pay changed {change}% vs last month
issues.leaver: Leaver — final month (prepare the final settlement separately)

notes.unpaidLeave: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} × daily rate ({basis}-day basis)

salaries.title: Salaries
salaries.description: Current monthly salary per employee. Open an employee's Payroll tab to see the history or schedule a change.

adjustments.title: One-time adjustments
adjustments.description: Bonuses, overtime, reimbursements and one-off deductions for a month. They are picked up when that month's payroll is calculated.
adjustments.addDescription: Paid (or deducted) once, in the chosen month's payroll.

settlements.title: Final settlements
settlements.description: End-of-service: unpaid salary + leave encashment + gratuity + other earnings − deductions. Prepared by one person, approved by another.
settlements.leaversDescription: Open the employee's Payroll tab to prepare one.

settings.title: Payroll settings
settings.description: Pay components, proration, WPS and end-of-service rules. UAE defaults are pre-loaded and editable.
settings.componentsIntro: Monthly components make up an employee's salary structure; one-time components are used for monthly adjustments. Formulas can use other components, e.g. {example1} or {example2}.

componentDialog.systemNote: System component: code, type and recurrence are fixed.
componentDialog.name: Name
componentDialog.formulaHint: Use + − × ÷, brackets, min/max/round/floor/ceil/abs and component codes: {codes}
componentDialog.taxableHint: For reporting; UAE has no personal income tax

settingsForm.basisHint: Used for joiners, leavers, salary changes mid-month and unpaid leave.
settingsForm.pdfPasswordHint: Password: date of birth as DDMMYYYY (employee number if no date of birth).
settingsForm.wpsDescription: Printed in the SIF header. Get these from your bank / MOHRE registration.
settingsForm.bankCodeHint: 9-digit agent ID of the bank that submits the file
settingsForm.gratuityDescription: Defaults follow UAE Labour Law (Federal Decree-Law 33/2021): 21 days' basic per year for the first 5 years, 30 days after, capped at 2 years' wages, nothing under 1 year.
settingsForm.encashmentHint: Unused balance of leave types marked encashable

salaryDialog.title: Change salary
salaryDialog.description: Applies from the effective date; earlier months keep the previous salary. Mid-month changes are pro-rated.
salaryDialog.deleteDescription: The change from {date} has not started yet.

approveSettlement.label: Approve settlement for {name}
approveSettlement.title: Approve final settlement for {name}?
approveSettlement.description: Total payable {total}. The settlement is locked once approved.

section.noSalaryInEffect: No salary in effect — payroll will flag this employee.
section.recordTermination: Record the termination first to prepare a final settlement.

errors.noneIncluded: No employees are included in this run.
errors.fixFirstMore: Fix or hold/exclude these first: {list} (+{count} more)
errors.makerChecker: Maker-checker: a run must be approved by someone other than the person who calculated or submitted it.
errors.runChanged: This run changed while you were releasing it. Reload and try again.
errors.periodReleased: {period} payroll is already released for this employee. Enter it in a later month.
errors.adjustmentPaid: This adjustment was paid in a released payroll and can't be deleted.
errors.exportApproved: This export is available once the run is approved or released.
errors.exportCalculated: This export is available once the run is calculated or under_review or approved or released.
errors.systemFixed: System components keep their code, type and recurrence.
errors.oneTimeAmounts: One-time components are entered as amounts
errors.terminated: Cannot change the salary of a terminated employee.
errors.onlyRecurringEarnings: Salary structures can only contain active recurring earnings.
errors.basicRequired: Basic salary is required (it drives gratuity and leave encashment).
errors.beforeJoin: Effective date is before the join date.
errors.dateUsed: There is already a salary starting on that date.
errors.onlyFuture: Only future (scheduled) salary changes can be deleted. Add a new change instead.
errors.noStructure: This employee has no salary structure, so gratuity can't be calculated.
errors.recordTermination: Record the termination (last working day) before preparing the final settlement.
errors.onlyDraft: Only draft settlements can be approved.
errors.settlementMakerChecker: Maker-checker: someone other than the preparer must approve the settlement.

success.salaryBackdated: Salary saved. It is backdated over released payroll ({period}) — add an arrears adjustment if the difference must be paid.
success.calculatedSkipped: Calculated {count} employees. Skipped {skipped} already in another run for this month.
success.released: Released. Payslips are available to employees.
success.reopened: Run reopened. Its payslips are withdrawn until it is released again.

export.name: Name
export.sifBlocked: The WPS file was not generated because of {count} problem(s):
export.sifHint: Fix the data and recalculate, hold the affected employees, or add ?force=1 to download anyway.

sif.employerId: Company WPS employer ID must be 13 digits (Payroll → Settings).
sif.employerBankCode: Employer bank routing code must be 9 digits (Payroll → Settings).
sif.routingCode: {employee}: bank routing code must be 9 digits
